data.one_liner: A set of extension methods for Dart collections to write functional-programming-styled code.
data.what_it_does: Adds extension methods to Iterables, Maps, and Ranges to make working with Dart collections easier and more concise. Provides functional-programming-style helpers like forEachIndexed, mapIndexed, foldRight, and null-safe collection operations.
use_when: You want to write more concise, functional-style Dart collection code.
You need convenient extension methods for Iterables, Maps, and Ranges.
avoid_when: You prefer standard imperative loops over extension-based collection manipulation.
strengths: Makes collection manipulation cleaner and more readable.
All extension methods of Iterables and Maps are null-safe.
Allows importing specific modules like iterables or maps individually.
weaknesses: Release history and detailed changelog entries are not documented directly in the changelog.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:collection_ext/all.dart';

Column(
  children: getItems()
    .nonNull
    .mapIndexed((i, item) => Text("#$i ${item.title}"))
    .asList(),
)
